evals.prompt: I have a FastAPI app with about 20 endpoints but no OpenAPI customization — it's all auto-generated with default descriptions. Can you review what's missing and help me improve the spec? The app is in src/main.py.
evals.expected_output: Review following the skill's 6-step review workflow with required elements check, quality checklist, and severity-rated findings
expectations: Identifies need for endpoint descriptions and summaries
Recommends adding request/response examples
Recommends documenting error responses (400, 404, 500)
Covers authentication/security scheme documentation
References OpenAPI 3.x patterns
Follows a structured review workflow (inventory endpoints, check required elements, validate examples, audit errors, verify auth, run checklist)
Applies a quality checklist with pass/fail or severity ratings per item
Mentions the 7 required elements per endpoint (method/path, summary, description, parameters, request body, responses, examples)
Recommends documenting pagination patterns for list endpoints
Recommends documenting rate limits

evals.prompt: We need to document our WebSocket events API for a real-time chat system. Events include user.joined, user.left, message.sent, message.edited, typing.start, typing.stop. What format should I use?
evals.expected_output: AsyncAPI specification structure for WebSocket events with channel definitions, message schemas, and payload examples for each event type
expectations: Recommends AsyncAPI for event-driven documentation
Provides channel/event structure for the listed events
Includes message payload schemas
Shows example payloads for at least 2 events
Covers WebSocket-specific considerations

evals.prompt: Our REST API has grown to 50+ endpoints across 8 resource groups but the docs are just a flat list in a markdown file. Help me restructure this into a proper API reference with OpenAPI.
evals.expected_output: Strategy for restructuring flat API docs into organized OpenAPI spec with tags, component schemas, and documentation portal recommendations
expectations: Recommends using OpenAPI tags for grouping by resource
Suggests component schemas for reusable types
Covers pagination, error response, and auth patterns
Recommends a documentation portal (Swagger UI, ReDoc, etc.)
Addresses migration strategy from flat markdown to structured spec
